text:
Noor (Design): quick thread on chart fidelity and microdash clutter. two visual ideas: reduce tile gridlines and offer a compact legend that expands on click. also rethink unit toggle wording.
Felix (Frontend): agreed on compact legend. expand-on-click for mobile, hover reveal for desktop. keep full names in aria-labels.
Ada (Product): naming: instead of Smart/Full or Auto/Raw i'd prefer 'Units: Readable | Raw' 14 users say 'Readable' sounds friendlier in docs.
Noor (Design): 'Readable | Raw' is nice. tooltip for Readable: 'Readable: abbreviates large numbers (K, M), removes decimals in compact views.'
Samir (Data): for tick snapping we should use 1,2,5 * 10^n steps to avoid strange decimals. compute based on tile max so tiny values don't become 0.0K.
Felix (Frontend): implementable. will add tickSnap util. also microcharts should use downsampled points w/ hover that reveals 'previewed data' hint.
Noor (Design): gridlines: microtiles look noisy at 1px. propose 'grid.micro' at 0.6px with slightly higher alpha. show both in mock.
a11y-bot: accessibility warning: fractional px strokes render inconsistently and can fail contrast. ensure grid color meets >= 3:1 contrast vs background. provide alternate token for low-dpi. collapsed legends must have focusable controls and visible focus ring.
Felix (Frontend): canvas approach: draw hairline via transform + alpha. svg border hacks unreliable on some browsers. i'll prototype both.
Ada (Product): smoothing default: ops asked to avoid fake dips. default to linear (no smoothing) for dashboards; offer 'Smooth: Gentle' as opt-in. we could offer a new algorithm 'preserve-peaks' instead of monotone spline.
Samir (Data): 'preserve-peaks' sounds promising. Savitzky-Golay tuned to avoid peak attenuation is an option. default=no smoothing; let users enable 'Gentle (preserve peaks)'. document behavior in tooltip.
Noor (Design): outliers are thorny. ops wants clamp; analysts want raw. new idea: combine clamp + horizon overlay: clamp main y-axis to avoid scale explosion, and render outliers as a thin 'horizon strip' above chart with mini glyphs so users still see spikes. legend menu can toggle 'Show full range' to re-scale.
Felix (Frontend): horizon overlay is an interesting UI. easier to implement as an overlay layer with same x-scale but separate y-band. also add legend kebab -> 'Show full range (includes outliers)'. aria-label will announce state change.
Samir (Data): compute clamp using 99th percentile or 4*MAD, whichever is smaller. overlay will position outliers proportionally in the strip and include hover details with true values.
Ada (Product): copy for legend action: 'Show full range (includes outliers)'. mobile friendly and explicit.
a11y-bot: ensure overlay outliers are keyboard-navigable and described via aria-describedby. color contrast of glyphs in horizon must meet 3:1. also if legend is icon-only, include visually-hidden description for SR users.
Noor (Design): rollout: dashboards first under a flag; keep embeds/exports legacy for one release. run AB test: 25% traffic, measure expand-to-full-chart rate, support mentions 'missing spike', and a quick readability micro-survey.
Felix (Frontend): will add feature flag chart.ui.microdash_v2 and telemetry hooks: legend.reveal_full and chart.overlay_outliers.toggled. will include perf notes on canvas overlay cost.
Samir (Data): add telemetry for smoothing toggles and whether overlay is used. also log when downsampled preview hides spikes so we can quantify confusion.
Ada (Product): perfect. Noor pls add mocks and microcopy keys: units.toggle.readable='Readable' units.toggle.raw='Raw' legend.action.showFull='Show full range (includes outliers)'.
Noor (Design): will upload mocks with grid.micro and horizon overlay examples, annotate accessibility and smoothing notes, and mark ready-for-design-qa. :white_check_mark:
